text: A field path shall be a nonempty list of zero-based nonnegative decimal indices. Each index shall select an existing field; each intermediate field shall resolve to an inline record. Empty, negative, out-of-range, dynamic, or pointer-traversing paths shall be statically rejected without wrapping indices.
